notes: Safer ghost: other apps can't control ghost, keys never go into backups, big or broken files are stopped, the PC window is sealed, and the website got a phone menu and download section.

features.title: ghost is locked tighter
features.text: Other apps can't make ghost do things, backups never carry your keys, giant or broken files are stopped, and the PC window is sealed off from your computer.
features.text_ro: Doosri apps ghost se kaam nahi karwa saktin, backup mein aap ki keys nahi jaatin, bohat bari ya kharab files ruk jaati hain, aur PC wali window computer se alag band hai.

features.title: New ghost for your PC
features.text: One screen: ghost stands in the middle and almost everything is one click around it. Money, files, emails, music, lock, screenshot and more.
features.try: look at my screen and help
features.text_ro: Ek hi screen: beech mein ghost, aur takreeban har kaam ek click par. Paisa, files, emails, gaane, lock, screenshot aur bohat kuch.
features.try_ro: meri screen dekho aur madad karo

features.title: One ask, many jobs
features.text: Say several things at once. ghost makes a plan and does them one by one, and still asks before sending anything.
features.try: add 500 for food and remind me at 9 to call Ali
features.text_ro: Kai kaam ek saath bolo. ghost plan bana kar ek ek kar ke karta hai, aur bhejne se pehle poochta hai.
features.try_ro: 500 khane ka likho aur 9 baje Ali ko call yaad dilao

features.title: WhatsApp, read out loud
features.text: ghost reads your new WhatsApp messages and replies for you after you say yes. Nothing is saved.
features.text_ro: ghost naye WhatsApp messages parh kar sunata hai aur aap ki haan ke baad jawab deta hai. Kuch save nahi hota.

features.title: Bill photo → money record
features.text: Show ghost a bill. It reads the total and the shop, and adds it to your spending after you say yes.
features.text_ro: Bill dikhayein. ghost total aur dukaan parh kar aap ki haan ke baad hisaab mein likh deta hai.

features.title: PDF, Word and Excel
features.text: ghost makes files for you and reads the ones you give it. Phone: Downloads → ghost. PC: Documents → ghost.
features.try: make an excel sheet of my expenses
features.text_ro: ghost files bana deta hai aur aap ki files parh leta hai. Phone: Downloads → ghost. PC: Documents → ghost.
features.try_ro: make an excel sheet of my expenses

features.title: More control
features.text: Brightness, Do Not Disturb, silent, screenshot, lock, next song. With Ghost Hands: tap, type and scroll in any app.
features.text_ro: Brightness, Do Not Disturb, silent, screenshot, lock, agla gaana. Ghost Hands se: kisi bhi app mein tap, type aur scroll.

features.title: Free, Pro and Business
features.text: Pro and Business need no API key at all, and your PC uses the same plan. See ⚙️ → Plans.
features.text_ro: Pro aur Business mein API key ki zaroorat nahi, aur PC bhi wahi plan use karta hai. ⚙️ → Plans dekhein.

features.title: ghost Business
features.text: A spoken business report: emails, Instagram, projects and money. Reply to Instagram comments by voice.
features.text_ro: Business report sunein: emails, Instagram, projects aur paisa. Instagram comments ka jawab awaz se.

features.title: This update screen
features.text: From now on every update shows you what's new, right here. See it again any time: ⚙️ → What's new.
features.text_ro: Ab har update mein yahin dikhega kya naya hai. Dobara dekhna ho: ⚙️ → What's new.
